_note: Exact model names and free-tier limits are confirmed at run time from each provider's live model list and limits page; 'verified' records when. Limits are applied at 80% (Limits.safety).

claude.provider: Claude subscription via Claude Code headless mode (claude -p)
claude._system_prompt_note: '' replaces Claude Code's default system prompt; confirm via input token count on the first live call.

gemini.limits_source: Google AI Studio > Rate Limit page, Free tier, read 2026-10-26. Flash models (3.6/3.8 Flash): 5 RPM, 250K TPM, 20 RPD; Flash-Lite (3.5/3.1): 15 RPM, 250K TPM, 500 RPD.
gemini.choice_reason: Flash models' 20 RPD would need 10+ days for the pilot alone; 3.5 Flash Lite is the newest non-preview text model with 500 RPD.

groq.limits_source: x-ratelimit-* headers on a live call 2026-10-26: limit-requests=1000 (per day), limit-tokens=8000 (per minute). Groq docs table also lists 200K tokens/day (not reported in headers; a per-day 429 stops the run cleanly).
groq.choice_reason: Live Groq list (2026-10-26) has no Llama 3.3 70B; chat models are gpt-oss-120b/20b and qwen3.8-27b. Qwen is planned for self-hosting, so gpt-oss-120b gives a distinct (OpenAI open-weight) family.

mistral.provider: Mistral La Plateforme, free Experiment plan (data-training opt-in)

vllm.provider: Self-hosted with vLLM on an NVIDIA Brev GPU (Brev credits); see docs/BREV_SETUP.md
